title: Questions 161-163 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:All Residents
From:Curtis Mbeki
Date:July 2
Subject:Bicycle Storage

Dear Residents,

I am writing about a growing problem with the way bicycles are being kept in the building. Over the past 2 weeks, the security team has had to cut locks off the stair railings on four separate occasions. In every case, a resident had chained a bicycle to a railing rather than putting it away properly.

Please be aware that the storage room may only be used for bicycles that fit inside the racks. If you own a cargo bicycle or a trailer, do not try to force it into a rack. Instead, you must take it to the covered shelter at the back of the building. You can reach that area through the gate in the courtyard.

If you need to get rid of a bicycle that is too heavy to move on your own, do not leave it in the corridor. You should contact Ms. Adeyemi in the building office and ask for it to be taken away for a small charge.

Thank you for helping us keep the building safe.

Curtis Mbeki
Security Supervisor
